therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhancement of radioiodine uptake and retention in thyroid cancer cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with recurrent or metastatic thyroid cancer

biomarker_changes: Serum thyroglobulin decreased by 29.1% in selumetinib arm vs increased by 4.3% in placebo arm (p=0.0756)
safety_signals: Grade 3+ adverse events: 6/28 selumetinib arm vs 1/30 placebo arm
